scope: One read-only exact join of the already frozen FIT/selection/qualification roster against retained canonical TRAIN metadata. No extra rows, role reallocation, pseudo-labels, inference model, task forward, train update, GPU, or remote persistence.
pair_rule: Exact same token list and same two ordered spans reversed, both directions observed and both rows retained within the same role. No absent edge is a negative; no role swap of cached h. Genuine directional supervision requires different observed labels.
qualification: Count span reciprocity only outside FIT. Do not extract or index selection/qualification label fields or use these roles to estimate the inverse map.

feasibility_only.fit: At least 2 distinct unordered observed label pairs, each in independent groups >=2; an absolute floor for comparing cross-label rather than one memorized relation type.
feasibility_only.qualification: At least 5 reciprocal sentence groups even under the optimistic assumption that all yield directional examples; 5 is the all-wins lower-limit illustration for a one-sided exact sign calculation at alpha .05, not a claimed power calculation or a new inferential gate.
feasibility_only.must_add: Any design still needs a distinguishable forward mechanism, qualifying independent controls and honest analysis of generalizability. Contrast applied to same logits alone is not a quantum contribution. Prior cohort and launch gates stay frozen.

when_unqualified: Return NONE for this route under the current profile. Do not collect/reallocate cases or add a pseudo-label inverse to bypass weak support.
